title: 第7章  柳如烟嘚瑟起来了
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
谢逸听了谢莲心的话，心中甚是触动，这么懂事，谁说她孤僻乖戾的？
“立了功劳自然要奖励，你说，你想要什么都行。”谢逸笑道。
谢莲心心里道：我要你告诉所有人我是你女儿，你肯吗？我要你跟我娘亲和好，你肯吗？
这些话，她只能想想，说不出来，她只能说：“欠着吧，师尊你先欠着，等我想好了要什么，再告诉你。”
谢逸笑着点点头：“好，你慢慢想。”
谢莲心走后不久，谢逸就召集了玄天宗的炼金师傀儡师们，众人见了谢逸拿出的灵力回路图纸，一个个震惊不已。
火炼峰峰主诸葛明震惊又激动地望着谢逸：“宗主，这、这是您想出来的吗？这、这实在是太了不起了，太让人震惊了。”
“不是，是莲心。”谢逸说。
“莲心师侄，这、这怎么可能呢？”诸葛明不信，其他的炼金师傀儡师也是不信的。谢莲心才多大呢？她能有这造诣，多半是宗主想出来的，给她贴金呢。哎，宗主啊，就是太宠着这小丫头了。
“是她想出来的。好了，你们先给我炼制个三百具出来吧。需要多长时间？”谢逸说。
诸葛明跟火炼峰诸长老们对视一样，又思考了一下：“至少半年。”
谢逸觉得这速度有点慢了，但想到第一次做，半年就半年吧。
谢逸离开了火炼峰之后，诸葛明等人就立即忙活了起来。他们在忙碌地制作傀儡的时候，谢莲心也没闲着，她也在抓紧制作傀儡，更高级的傀儡。
她知道自己很快就要去界面要塞了，她想要借此机会，溜出去找她母亲。
她爹不会让她去见她娘，到了边界要塞，就不在他眼皮子底下了。
她要做好了各种准备。
————
一个月之后。
大殿之中，一袭白衣的男子正在看着一卷古籍，他低垂着视线，墨黑的长发如同流水般倾泻过肩头。
两个少女从外面进来，走到了男子不远处，齐齐行礼：

“师尊！”
谢逸放下了手中的古籍，看向了自己女儿和弟子。
“叫你们两个过来，你们可知道为了什么？”谢逸问道。
谢莲心没有说话，旁边的柳如烟娇滴滴地道：“师尊，可是为了去界面要塞历练之事？”
诸天万界中跟魔界相交的界面有上百个，灵界也是其中之一。这些界面跟魔界的相交之处很容易产生天然的界门，界门一出现，就会有大批的魔族过来，肆虐众生。
所以仙盟在容易出现界门的地方都设置了边界要塞，并且派人轮流驻守。
前往要塞驻守历练是所有修士都会经历的事情。
按照玄天宗的规矩，通常情况是筑基开始就要去边界要塞历练了。
筑基历练半年，金丹两年，元婴三年，化神十年。炼虚期之后，就不是历练，而是轮流驻守要塞，每一次的时间至少是五十年。
谢莲心四岁筑基，谁会让四岁的娃娃去历练啊？她现在也不过是十四岁而已，所以她虽然已经是元婴后期了，但从未去过要塞。
现在柳如烟是筑基期了，她是刚进入筑基期不久，也还没去过边界要塞。
像这种历练之事，通常都是每十年就组织一次的，宗内弟子，凡是符合情况，并且没有特殊原因的，都会参与。
谢逸想着女儿莲心和徒弟柳如烟都已经符合历练要求了，就打算也让她们两个跟着去见见世面。
“没错，你们的师兄师姐他们马上就要去佳孟关了，你们两个也跟着去看看吧。”谢逸道。
柳如烟恭恭敬敬地行礼：“是，师尊！”
她转头看了眼旁边的谢莲心，“按照规矩，我去半年就可以回来了，师姐已经是元婴了，那必须在佳孟关待上三年了。”
想到自己回来后，两年半都不用看到谢莲心，这整个玉阳峰就剩下了自己跟师尊，柳如烟心中很是高兴。她想着想着，秀丽的面颊绯红了起来。
“不用，半年，你们一起回来就好。”谢逸说。
他不舍得让十四岁的女儿离开三年。
规矩是死的，人是活的。按照规定，元婴期是必须要去边关历练三年，但他这个宗主发了话，还有谁人敢说个不字？

柳如烟的微笑凝固了。
师尊这是舍不得谢莲心吗？
谢逸一抬手，就见一块系着红绳的玉佩出现在虚空中，那玉佩朝着柳如烟飞去，停留在了她面前。
柳如烟惊讶地望着谢逸，谢逸淡淡地道：“如烟，你修为尚低，去要塞要听从师兄师姐的吩咐，这碧心佩你戴着防身吧。”
柳如烟欢喜不已，捧着那快雕成玉佩，见这玉佩散发出青色霞光，仙气环绕，激动地道：“多谢师尊！”
她低头看着手中的碧心佩，心里甜蜜无比，师尊果然还是在意自己的。
柳如烟瞥了眼旁边的谢莲心，隐隐地透着点得意。
谢莲心心里切了一声。
不就是一件防身的仙宝吗？有什么可得意的。
接着谢逸又一挥手，就见四个蒙着面纱的青衣少女出现在了柳如烟面前，这四个青衣少女朝着柳如烟盈盈一拜，柳如烟见她们动作神态都跟其他傀儡不同，心中震惊。
“这四具大乘期傀儡你也带上吧。”谢逸道，诸葛明他们的任务还没完成，这四具傀儡是谢逸自己做的。
“大乘期的傀儡？”柳如烟从未听过有大乘期的傀儡，她激动无限地望着谢逸，面颊泛红，“师尊，这是您亲手做的吗？”
谢逸点了点头。
柳如烟面颊更红了，更激动了。
“多谢师尊！”
“这四具傀儡虽然不需要消耗你的神识，但是这是你保命之物，平日不要拿出来炫耀。”谢逸交代。
“是。”柳如烟恭恭敬敬地一拜，又侧头暗暗瞥了眼谢莲心，眼底有得意之色溢出来。
谢莲心看向那四具傀儡，这四具傀儡使用的是她那套灵力回路。
这四个家伙送到柳如烟身边正好了，她随意可以通过这四具傀儡监视柳如烟。随时能让她们拧断柳如烟的脖子。
监视这家伙，也许，她就能知道这家伙是怎么勾搭上黑天帝的，再顺藤摸瓜，将黑天帝给揪出来弄死了。

黑天帝的事情只在脑子里过了一下，她就忙抛开了那念头，看着自己父亲。
谢逸金色眼瞳也正好朝着她看过来，他道：“你的话，我就不给你法宝了。”他说完伸出手指，隔空朝着谢莲心一点，三道剑气涌入了谢莲心眉心之中，封印在了她的体内。
content_en:
Xie Yi was deeply moved after hearing Xie Lianxin's words. Who said she was withdrawn and surly if she was so sensible?
"Of course you will be rewarded for your merits. You can say whatever you want." Xie Yi said with a smile.
Xie Lianxin thought to herself: I want you to tell everyone that I am your daughter, are you willing? I want you to reconcile with my mother, are you willing?
She could only think about these words but could not say them out. She could only say: "I owe you. Master, you owe me first. I will tell you after I have decided what I want."
Xie Yi smiled and nodded: "Okay, think about it slowly."
Not long after Xie Lianxin left, Xie Yi summoned the alchemist puppet masters of the Xuantian Sect. Everyone was shocked when they saw the spiritual power circuit drawings that Xie Yi took out.
Zhuge Ming, the leader of Huolian Peak, looked at Xie Yi in shock and excitement: "Sect Master, did you come up with this? This, this is really amazing, so shocking."
"No, it's Lian Xin." Xie Yi said.
"Nephew Lianxin, how is this possible?" Zhuge Ming didn't believe it, and neither did the other alchemist puppet masters. How old is Xie Lianxin? The reason why she has such attainments was probably the idea of ​​the sect leader, who gave her some gold. Hey, Sect Leader, you just dote on this little girl too much.
"She came up with it. Okay, you can refine three hundred tools for me first. How long will it take?" Xie Yi said.
Zhuge Ming looked at each other like the elders at Huolianfeng and thought for a moment: "At least half a year."
Xie Yi felt that the speed was a bit slow, but when he thought of doing it for the first time, half a year would be enough.
After Xie Yi left Huolian Peak, Zhuge Ming and others immediately got busy. While they were busy making puppets, Xie Lianxin was not idle either. She was also working hard to make puppets, more advanced puppets.
She knew that she would be going to the Interface Fortress soon, and she wanted to take this opportunity to sneak out and find her mother.
Her father would not let her go to see her mother, and when she arrived at the border fortress, she would not be under his nose.
She had to make all kinds of preparations.
————
One month later.
In the main hall, a man in white clothes was reading a volume of ancient books. He lowered his gaze, and his long black hair poured over his shoulders like running water.
The two girls came in from outside, walked not far from the man, and saluted in unison:
"Master!"
Xie Yi put down the ancient book in his hand and looked at his daughter and disciple.
"Do you know why I called you two here?" Xie Yi asked.
Xie Lianxin didn't say anything, and Liu Ruyan beside her said delicately: "Master, is it to go to the Interface Fortress for training?"
There are hundreds of interfaces between the heavens and the demon world, and the spiritual world is one of them. The intersection between these interfaces and the demon world can easily create natural gates. Once the gates appear, a large number of demons will come over and wreak havoc on all living beings.
Therefore, the Immortal Alliance has set up border fortresses in places where boundary gates are prone to appear, and sent people to guard them in turns.
Going to the fortress to garrison and gain experience is something that all monks will experience.
According to Xuantian Sect's rules, it is usually necessary to go to the border fortress to practice at the beginning of foundation building.
Half a year of foundation building experience, two years of golden elixir training, three years of Nascent Soul training, and ten years of spiritual transformation. After the virtual refining period, it is no longer training, but taking turns to garrison the fortress, each time for at least fifty years.
Xie Lianxin built her foundation at the age of four. Who would let a four-year-old baby go through it? She is only fourteen years old now, so although she is already in the late Nascent Soul stage, she has never been to the fortress.
Now Liu Ruyan is in the foundation building stage. She has just entered the foundation building stage and has not been to the border fortress yet.
Training events like this are usually organized once every ten years. Disciples within the sect who meet the circumstances and have no special reasons will participate.
Xie Yi thought that his daughter Lian Xin and his apprentice Liu Ruyan had met the training requirements, so he planned to let them follow him to see the world.
"That's right, your senior brothers and sisters are about toWe are about to go to Jiameng Pass. You two should go and have a look too. "Xie Yi said.
Liu Ruyan saluted respectfully: "Yes, Master! "
She turned to look at Xie Lianxin next to her, "According to the rules, I can come back in half a year. Senior sister is already a Nascent Soul, so she must stay in Jiameng Pass for three years. "
Liu Ruyan was very happy when she thought that after she came back, she wouldn't have to see Xie Lianxin for two and a half years, and that only she and her master would be left in Yuyang Peak. As she thought about it, her beautiful cheeks turned red.
"No, you can come back together in half a year. "Xie Yi said.
He was reluctant to leave his fourteen-year-old daughter for three years.
Rules are dead, people are alive. According to regulations, one must go to the border to practice for three years in the Nascent Soul stage, but if he, the sect leader, has spoken, who else dares to say no?
Liu Ruyan's smile froze.
Master, are you reluctant to thank Lian Xin?
As soon as Xie Yi raised his hand, he saw a jade pendant tied with a red rope appearing in the void. The jade pendant flew towards Liu Ruyan and stopped in front of her.
Liu Ruyan looked at Xie Yi in surprise, and Xie Yi said calmly: "Ruyan, your cultivation level is still low. Go to the fortress and follow the instructions of your senior brother and sister. You should wear this Bi Xin Pei for self-defense. "
Liu Ruyan was overjoyed, holding the jade pendant that was quickly carved, and saw that the jade pendant was emitting a green glow, surrounded by fairy energy, and said excitedly: "Thank you, Master! "
She lowered her head and looked at the Bixin Pei in her hand, feeling extremely sweet in her heart. The Master really still cared about her.
Liu Ruyan glanced at Xie Lianxin next to her, feeling faintly proud.
Xie Lian's heart skipped a beat.
Isn't it just a magical treasure for self-defense? Nothing to be proud of.
Then Xie Yi waved his hand again, and saw four veiled girls in Tsing Yi appearing in front of Liu Ruyan. The four girls in Tsing Yi bowed to Liu Ruyan. Liu Ruyan was shocked when he saw that their movements and expressions were different from other puppets.
"You should also take these four Mahayana stage puppets with you. "Xie Yi said, Zhuge Ming and the others haven't completed their mission yet. These four puppets were made by Xie Yi himself.
“A puppet from the Mahayana period? Liu Ruyan had never heard of a puppet in the Mahayana stage. She looked at Xie Yi with excitement, her cheeks flushed, "Master, did you make this yourself?" "
Xie Yi nodded.
Liu Ruyan's cheeks became redder and more excited.
"Thank you Master! "
"Although these four puppets do not need to consume your spiritual consciousness, they are your life-saving things. Don't show them off on weekdays. "Xie Yi explained.
"Yes. "Liu Ruyan bowed respectfully, then turned her head and glanced secretly at Xie Lianxin, with a proud look in her eyes.
Xie Lianxin looked at the four puppets. These four puppets used her spiritual circuit.
It was just right that these four guys were sent to Liu Ruyan. She could monitor Liu Ruyan through these four puppets at will. They could break Liu Ruyan's neck at any time.
By monitoring this guy, maybe she can figure out how this guy hooked up with Emperor Heitian, and then follow the clues to find out and kill Emperor Heitian.
The matter of Emperor Heitian only passed through her mind for a moment, and she quickly put the thought aside and looked at her father.
Xie Yi's golden eyes also happened to look towards her, and he said: "If you say so, I won't give you the magic weapon. "After he finished speaking, he stretched out his finger and pointed it towards Xie Lianxin from a distance. Three sword energy poured into Xie Lianxin's eyebrows and sealed it in her body.
